about: Which scene shows which app tool's result (director.play_tool). The data is what the tool returns: a map, a list of rows or plain text. '*' is any other tool: its text goes on a markdown card. 'title' heads a text card (only for tools whose text has no heading of its own); 'task' is what the working scene says while the tool runs.
